PR surface: Source +19, Tests +35, Other +57. Total +111 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for source-level reproduction: current main lacks a stderr stream `error` listener in `scpFile`, and a Node EventEmitter `error` without a listener throws. The PR body also includes a near-real terminal proof using a real child process stderr stream.

target.title: fix(auto-reply): handle stderr stream errors in sandbox media scpFile
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`scpFile` in `src/auto-reply/reply/stage-sandbox-media.ts` reads scp stderr for failure diagnostics but only attaches a `"data"` listener. If the stderr stream emits an `"error"` event during transfer or teardown, the error is unhandled and can crash the auto-reply staging flow.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added an `"error"` listener to `child.stderr` that rejects the promise, and introduced a `settled` guard so the first error/exit outcome wins. This prevents double rejection and matches the stream-error handling pattern used elsewhere.

## User Impact

Sandbox media staging via scp now fails gracefully with the stderr error instead of crashing on an unhandled stream error.

## Evidence

Regression test:

```bash
pnpm test src/auto-reply/reply/stage-sandbox-media.scp.test.ts
```

```
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  1 passed (1)
```


## Real behavior proof

Real process-level proof that a stderr stream error no longer crashes the auto-reply flow:

```bash
node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/proof/stage-sandbox-media-scp-stream-errors.mts
```

```
=== Proof: stage-sandbox-media scpFile stderr stream error handling ===

Rejected with: stderr EPIPE

PASS: stderr stream error was caught and scpFile rejected cleanly.
```
